name: plot-prep-quick-plot-test
summary: Test processor-plot-prep in front of quick-plot: Fargate stage, then Lambda stage, then the viewer asset
description: Two-processor test workflow, run by hand with POST /runs. processor-plot-prep (Fargate) passes a CSV through unchanged, pennsieve-quick-plot-test (Lambda; a fork of pennsieve-quick-plot) draws it with the csv_column_distributions template, and the viewer-asset target attaches the PNG. A PNG at the end proves the folder hand-off between stages and standard -> lambda in one run, with no quick-plot code change. Replace organizationId and the quick-plot tag before POSTing to /definitions.
